title: Fix the Indentation
description: A script is broken due to indentation mistakes. Correct it.
problemStatement:
Your teammate wrote a script but it throws an `IndentationError`. The code is:

```python
print("Starting hack...")
if True:
print("Hacking in progress")
  print("Access granted")
print("Done")
```

Copy this into a new file `fix_indent.py`, identify the indentation errors, and fix them so that the output becomes:
```
Starting hack...
Hacking in progress
Access granted
Done
```
hints: The lines after a colon (`:`) must be indented consistently.
All lines in the same block need the same number of spaces (4 is standard).
The line `print("Access granted")` should be part of the `if` block.
expectedOutput:
Starting hack...
Hacking in progress
Access granted
Done
solutionCode:
print("Starting hack...")
if True:
    print("Hacking in progress")
    print("Access granted")
print("Done")
